status: Geometry frozen; focused CPU checks and the fresh source-aft-return fidelity, geometry and official standard all pass. Mandatory final full-fleet integration remains parent-owned and pending.

provenance.method: Complete canonical source rays plus connected-island scalar plane measurements. Runtime is an original closed piecewise-planar height envelope; no source vertex, index, UV or texture data is used.

defect.description: The previous broad flat fender plus separate flat rubber flap missed the rolled inner edge and filled source air above the sloping return.

authoredCorrection.scope: Only the two aft returns and the rear endpoint of each existing long side fender. Main hull, running gear, turret, gun and all unrelated equipment remain unchanged.
authoredCorrection.construction: Independent top and underside plane fields with a real transverse fold and rolled terminal closure. Left and right terminal fields are different, not a mirrored flat slab.
authoredCorrection.ownership: Permanent hull-owned mudguard equipment; no expendable ERA registration.
inferencesAndLimits: An 8 mm concealed longitudinal receiving lap and the scalar-flat 1.25398 m join crown ensure positive attachment to the retained original forward fender; no global fender or hull roof lift.
The very narrow outer side-edge wander is represented by a constant lateral construction boundary. This remains a millimetre-scale edge simplification, not an exact copy of the source perimeter.
The source's different left and right rolled terminal closure and all independently tested under-return air remain physical.
